name: The Elder's story
notes: The Elder explains where to go and how the world works.

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: AH, ANOTHER WANDERER. NO EYES, NO VOICE... YOU LOOK LIKE THE OLD VESSELS.

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: BELOW DUSTMERE LIES WHAT IS LEFT OF UNDERHIVE. THE GLARE TOOK ITS BUGS.

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: THEY SAY A VESSEL SLEEPS IN THE BLACK TEMPLE, ABOVE THE WEEPING SPIRE.

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: IT HOLDS THE GLARE IN. BUT LATELY THE LIGHT DOWN THERE BURNS BRIGHTER...

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: TAKE THE WELL DOWN, IF YOU MUST. REST ON BENCHES TO SAVE YOUR WAY.

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: AND IF YOU FALL, FIND YOUR SHADE. IT KEEPS YOUR GEO UNTIL YOU BEAT IT.
